title: METAIS conformance driver request
description: The one request the runner writes to a driver's standard input for each step: the operation and its arguments as the vector wrote them, and where to write the stream bytes.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: The protocol and its major version.

op.title: Operation
op.description: An abstract operation of chapter 15, or version for the implementation's identity.

args.title: Arguments
args.description: The step's arguments exactly as the vector wrote them; paths are relative to the working directory. Empty for version.

stream_file.title: Stream file
stream_file.description: The file, relative to the working directory, that receives the stream's bytes when the step streams.
